messages.subject: Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 45462200 failed: Error parsing manifest: Maximum supported R version is: 3.2.0.
parts:
I am using R version 3.2.1 (session info below).  I get the following message when I try to deployApp function in shinyapps package (Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 45462200 failed: Error parsing manifest: Maximum supported R version is: 3.2.0.)
The detailed message is listed below. Did anyone face this problem and can guide me any work around this problem?
Thanks. ND

parts: The shinyapps.io platform does not currently support R 3.2.1 yet. We'll be adding support sometime this week though. In the meantime, try using R 3.2.0. Thanks.
